Walking and picking with G1G1 的行走与移动取放

The same public SONIC decoder drives a free-base humanoid through a five-metre walk, a right turn, and a walk to a table to pick and place an object. Explore the measured motion and the controls that produced it.同一公开 SONIC 解码器驱动自由基座人形机器人直行五米、向右转身，或走到桌前取放物体。下方可查看真实仿真运动和相应的控制量。

Walking, turning and stopping直行、转身与停车

The reference receives a relative route goal and numeric robot proprioception. Select a route, then scrub the measured pelvis trajectory. Coordinates follow the initial heading. Left is positive and right turns have negative yaw.参考策略读取相对路线目标和机器人本体感知数值。选择路线，拖动时间条查看骨盆实测轨迹。坐标以初始朝向为基准，横向向左为正，右转航向为负。

One continuous walk → hold → right turn一次连续的直行 → 停稳 → 右转

In a separate public demonstration, one reset and one decoder history carried the robot through both commands. The first stop was followed by a further 1.50 s hold. The command changed at 17.14 s; the 20.14 s run ended 5.018 m forward and 0.024 m left of the start. The turn itself was −85.1°. This demonstration has no separate ALE reward.在另一条公开演示中，两段指令共用一次复位和一份解码器历史。第一次停车后继续保持 1.50 秒，17.14 秒切换到转向指令。总计 20.14 秒，终点相对起点前进 5.018 米、向左 0.024 米；转向阶段为 −85.1°。该演示未单独计算 ALE 奖励。

When the next command arrives下一条指令到达时

This separate task reveals one instruction at a time. The robot walks 4.5–5.5 m and stops, receives a left or right turn, then receives a final 1–2 m walk after the next stop. Its physical state and decoder history continue across both reveals.这一独立任务逐段揭示指令。机器人先行走 4.5–5.5 米并停稳，才收到左转或右转指令；再次停稳后，才收到最后一段 1–2 米的行走距离。两次揭示之间，物理状态和解码器历史始终连续。

Before the reveal, the sensor packets, action rows and full joint states matched exactly. The pilot branches then received opposite 90° commands. Their final 1.50 m walk was revealed at 19.94 s on the left branch and 20.14 s on the right branch.揭示前，两条轨迹的传感包、动作行和完整关节状态逐项相同。两个试验随后接受方向相反的 90° 转向指令，第三段 1.50 米的行走指令分别在左转分支 19.94 秒、右转分支 20.14 秒揭示。

On a prespecified 12-run development panel, the reference completed all three stages in 12/12 runs, with no falls. Durations ranged from 19.30 to 24.88 s. An observation-blind control replayed the right turn when the hidden instruction was left and failed the direction gate.在预先规定的 12 个开发回合中，参考控制器 12/12 完成全部三段且无跌倒，用时 19.30–24.88 秒。一个不读取观测的对照在真实指令为左转时仍重放右转，未通过方向门槛。

Walk to the table, then place走到桌前，再完成放置

The mobile reference uses camera images and robot proprioception. It walks from an offset start, docks, and uses its right Dex3 hand. One physics state and decoder history run throughout.移动取放参考策略读取相机图像和机器人本体感知。从偏置起点走到桌前并站稳后，机器人用右侧 Dex3 手抓取。整个回合共用连续的物理状态与解码器历史。

    Approach recorded开始达到行走条件
    Forward movement and real foot motion.测得前进位移与双脚运动。
  2. 3.52 s
    Docked at the table桌前站稳

  3. 9.68 s
    First object contact首次接触物体
    Native contact between the hand and cylinder.原生碰撞解算检测到手与圆柱接触。
  4. 10.36 s
    Load-bearing lift承重举起
    Opposed digits carried the load above the support.相对手指承重，物体离开支撑面。

    The green pad supported the object for 250 ms with the hand clear.手部脱离后，绿垫连续承重 250 毫秒。

Measurement definitions and provenance测量定义与来源

One native action row has 64 integer FSQ coordinates, each in [0, 31]. The decoder produces 29 body joint targets every 20 ms. Hands receive separate closure commands in mobile manipulation.一个原生动作行含有 64 个 [0, 31] 范围内的 FSQ 整数坐标。解码器每 20 毫秒输出 29 个身体关节目标。移动取放时还会独立发出双手闭合命令。

The acceleration metric uses 29 measured joint velocities, differenced across 100 ms, pooled over joints and rows. Coordinate-change rate counts changed bins between consecutive action rows. The grey-green time band marks the final qualifying 0.75 s stop.加速度由相隔 100 毫秒的 29 个实测关节速度作差，再跨关节和控制行计算均方根。坐标变化率统计相邻动作行中发生变化的离散坐标。时间图中的灰绿色区域为最后合格的 0.75 秒停车窗口。

Walking traces were reconstructed from committed public controls and checked against SHA-256 digests of every native 2 ms sample. The mobile reference traces match the archived terminal metrics.行走曲线以实际提交的公开控制逐步重放，并核对了全部 2 毫秒原生样本的 SHA-256。移动取放曲线的终点指标与封存结果一致。
